title: Use the style reference code --sref 2645879446 to apply a Retro Dreamy Bokeh…
content:
Use the style reference code --sref 2645879446 to apply a Retro Dreamy Bokeh aesthetic in Seedance 2.0.  
Set --sw 500 with --sref 2645879446 to increase the strength/weight of the style reference.  
Set --stylize 500 to push stronger stylization when using --sref 2645879446.  
Use --v 7 with --sref 2645879446 to match Midjourney V7 style reference behavior.
